name: Lin BioScience, Inc.
summary: Lin BioScience, Inc. is an innovative biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel therapies across oncology, ophthalmology, and metabolic diseases. Its robust pipeline includes LBS-008, an orally administered treatment currently in Phase 3 clinical trials for adolescent Stargardt disease (STGD1) and Phase 2/3 trials for dry age-related macular degeneration (Dry AMD), both aimed at evaluating its safety and effectiveness. Other key candidates are LBS-007, a natural non-ATP CDC7 inhibitor designed to combat various cancers; LBS-002, an anti-tubulin compound targeting primary and metastatic brain tumors; and LBS-009, an oral medication for non-alcoholic fatty liver disease and Type 2 diabetes. The company is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
